column_3: Barrick’s interest is subject to royalty obligations at certain

In April 2009, Barrick increased its interest in the Hemlo mine
from 50% to 100%. 2008 production reflects Barrick’s then-current 50%
interest.

In March 2008, Barrick increased its interest in the Cortez mine
from 60% to 100%.

Effective in the first quarter of 2008, the Darlot, Lawlers and
Granny Smith mines have been consolidated under Yilgarn South for reporting
purposes.

In December 2009, Barrick committed to a plan to dispose of its
Osborne mine and expects to finalize a transaction in 2010.

In July 2009, Barrick sold the Henty mine to Bendigo Mining
Limited.
The Buzwagi mine commenced production in May 2009.
